g.text: Three-segment trick: one LLM, two losses
Turn a decoder-only LLM into an embedding model without giving up next-token prediction
PART II · GSU SIDE: REASONING ITEM ALIGNMENT
Why it works: the QA tokens cannot see the input, only the <EMB> tokens.
To answer, all item information must flow through the embedding.
Warm start: QA may see the input at first; that attention is annealed to zero.
QARM V2 (arXiv:2602.08559), §3.1.2 and Figure 3. Gradient cache is used for large contrastive batches
